posts.title: Journey of GIT
posts.desc: Today the path of programmer is filled with continuous learning of tools and concepts...
posts.intro: Today the path of programmer is filled with continuous learning of tools and concepts, here we come at a stop of Git...
posts.content:
DVCS a term for Distributed Version Control System, yeah we will go a little further into definition of this term, but before that understand version control and why we need it.
Maintaining versions of any document means having its copy of changes. Think about some painting before giving it a finishing look with colors or just keeping it to sketch the painter has gone through the changes of the drawing like


  1. First he drew the sketch with basic shapes
  2. Then added details and textures
  3. Finally, applied the finishing touches

but during the whole process he never starts again from another day, he start from where he left the drawing, means he always have a continuous workflow or we can say version of it's painting. Like this also we have changes in our codebase, the history of code.
